requirement_paraphrase: With vision unaided other than corrective lenses, the remote pilot in command, the visual observer (if used) and the person manipulating the controls must be able to see the aircraft throughout flight to know its location, determine attitude/altitude/direction, observe airspace for traffic or hazards, and determine it does not endanger others' life or property; under 107.31(b) this must be exercised by the RPIC and controls person, or by a visual observer.

Operating limits: groundspeed not above 87 knots (100 mph); altitude not above 400 ft AGL unless flown within a 400-foot radius of a structure and not above 400 ft over the structure's uppermost limit; flight visibility from the control station at least 3 statute miles; at least 500 ft below and 2,000 ft horizontally from clouds.
